title: chore(osv): renew the minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 exemption to 2026-12-21 with a lockfile-true reason
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1qGnTYLQs3EtmtCmjrcfCe)_
Fixes #35828

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只把依赖安全扫描里一条已知公告的豁免到期日从 11 月 30 日顺延到 12 月 21 日，并把理由改成与当前依赖锁文件一致的说法。
- 为什么做：这条豁免本月 30 日到期，到期后每日依赖扫描会在主分支转红；修复版本是破坏性大版本，还有两条依赖链没有任何版本接受它，所以只能续期。
- 出错会怎样：再接受这条只影响可用性的公告 30 天；已核对对外发布的包，没有一条路径会把请求里的内容当作匹配模式送进受影响的代码。直接撤回本 PR 即可，到期后扫描自动转红。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `osv-scanner.toml`, the GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 entry only: `ignoreUntil` 2026-11-30 becomes 2026-12-21 (a bare TOML date, the 30-day default from 2026-11-21), and the `reason` is rewritten to be true about today's `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
- Nothing else. No dependency moves (convention 3: a renewal goes alone), nothing publishes, so the PR carries `skip-changeset` and `osv-exemption`.

Files to read first:

1. `osv-scanner.toml`, the last block: the new date and the reason sentence. Risk hunk: the reason is the renewal decision itself; check its named holders against the lockfile table below.

Two-minute verification: `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs` prints `1 OSV exemption(s) in osv-scanner.toml: all carry an unexpired ignoreUntil within 90 days and a reason with an advisory link.`

## Why the entry cannot be removed yet

The only patched minimatch is 11.0.1, a breaking major. Every 10.x copy in the lockfile, by parent (`pnpm why minimatch -r --depth 1` at `36200897`):

| Locked parent | Holds | Newest release on npm (read 2026-11-21) | Can it reach 11 by a bump? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| @microsoft/api-extractor 7.58.2 (via tsup, unplugin-dts, vite-plugin-dts) | 10.2.6 | 7.60.1 declares `10.2.3` exact | no |
| glob 7.2.3 (via exceljs 4.4.0, through archiver 5.3.2's archiver-utils and unzipper 0.10.14's fstream and rimraf) | 10.2.6 (declares `^3.1.1`, lifted by the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override) | exceljs 4.4.0 is its newest and still declares archiver `^5` and unzipper `^0.10` | no |
| readdir-glob 1.1.3 (via archiver 5.3.2) | 10.2.6 (declares `^5.1.0`, lifted by the override) | readdir-glob 4.0.0 accepts `^11.0.1`, but archiver 5 declares `^1.1.2` and exceljs pins archiver 5 | no |
| eslint 10.13.0 | 10.2.6 | 10.15.0 declares `^11.0.5` | yes |
| @eslint/config-array 0.23.5 | 10.2.6 | 0.23.6 declares `^11.0.5` | yes |
| @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.1 | 10.2.6 | 8.73.0 declares `^11.0.1` | yes |
| @oclif/core 5.1.2 | 10.2.6 | 5.1.12 declares `^11.0.1` | yes |
| @ts-morph/common 0.29.0 (via ts-morph 28.0.0) | 10.2.6 | 0.29.1 declares `^11.0.1` | yes |

One 11.x copy already exists: minimatch 11.0.3 under glob 14.0.3.

So two chains block removal today: api-extractor and exceljs. The reason names both and says the five movable parents only move in a dependency bump.

## Shipped reach

Read with `pnpm why minimatch -r --prod`. Published packages that carry minimatch on a production dependency path:

- `@objectstack/cli`: through `@oclif/core` 5.1.2, on minimatch 10.2.6. oclif calls minimatch in one place, its plugin loader. There it matches the CLI's own dependency names against the plugin wildcard patterns in the CLI's own oclif config. Both sides come from the package manifest, not from a request, and the CLI runs locally.
- `@objectstack/rest`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-report`: through exceljs 4.4.0, which pulls in archiver 5.3.2 and unzipper 0.10.14. Under those are glob 7.2.3 and readdir-glob 1.1.3, both on minimatch 10.2.6. The code that would call minimatch is archiver's `glob` and `directory` entry points and unzipper's `Extract`. exceljs's own `lib/` calls none of them: a grep for those entry points, fstream, rimraf and minimatch finds nothing. `packages/rest/src` imports neither glob nor minimatch. The code is installed, but no request value reaches it as a pattern.
- `@objectstack/metadata`, `@object-ui/cli`: through glob 14.0.3, on minimatch 11.0.3. That is the patched line and the advisory does not apply.

So no request-influenced pattern reaches a 10.x minimatch in a published package. The other 10.x holders (eslint, typescript-eslint, api-extractor, ts-morph) are build and dev tooling.

## Tests

Run at head `36200897`.

- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs` :: exit 0, prints `1 OSV exemption(s) in osv-scanner.toml: all carry an unexpired ignoreUntil within 90 days and a reason with an advisory link.`
- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs --self-test` :: exit 0, prints `self-test passed: valid ledgers accepted, every convention breach rejected.`
- Python `tomllib` parses the file, and `ignoreUntil` reads back as a TOML `date` (not a string), so the scanner will not discard the file.

## Acceptance notes

- No new tests and no ablation. The diff is one ledger entry, and the ledger's own checker is its test.
- The old reason and the card named typedoc as a holder. typedoc is not in `pnpm-lock.yaml` (zero matches), so the new reason leaves it out. The old reason also named readdir-glob 3.0.0, but the lockfile holds 1.1.3. It also omitted glob 7.2.3 and @ts-morph/common, which do hold 10.x copies.
- Follow-up filed as #36160, its own dependency PR: move eslint to 10.15.0, @eslint/config-array to 0.23.6, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree to 8.73.0, @oclif/core to 5.1.12, and ts-morph or @ts-morph/common to 0.29.1. Each of those accepts minimatch 11. Even after that, the exemption stays until api-extractor ships a release that accepts 11 and the exceljs chain is resolved (exceljs has no newer release; an override retarget for glob 7 and readdir-glob 1 would need its own measurement).
- Scoped `pnpm lint`: none. The diff touches no package.

<details><summary>OSV scan reproduction: NOT MEASURED</summary>

`api.osv.dev` is refused by this container's egress proxy (HTTP 403). Running the v2.5.0 release binary locally was refused by the session's permission policy, so it was not run. The PR's own base-relative OSV steps in Validate Package Dependencies judge it in CI. The advisory text was not re-read for the same egress reason; its affected range (every release before 11.0.1) is as recorded in the original exemption's review.
